title: Calico published provenance manifest (v1)
description: Closed, row-free positive projection of accepted releases, source hashes/sizes/row counts, parser and allowlist versions, toolchain pins, eligible key count, and export provenance (D-10). Every field is explicitly assigned from validated safe input. Contains no local paths, credentials, exception text, excluded values, organization-level row content, or wall-clock field. The document validator additionally enforces distinct sorted identities and export name/file/grain agreement with the publication allowlist. Integer fields must decode to Python integers, never booleans or floating-point values.

parser_contract_version.description: Versioned parser contract identifier; no path or free text.

dbt_core.description: Exact three-part dbt Core version pin.

accepted_releases.description: Distinct accepted date/revision pairs sorted by date then revision.

eligible_key_count.description: Zero explicitly records the valid empty named-history state (D-23).

exports.description: Distinct approved exports sorted by export name; zero-row files remain present.

source_objects.description: The complete four-object canonical source-list set, sorted by source list.

file_name.description: Must equal export_name plus .csv and the approved file identity.

grain.description: Exact ordered grain from the approved export entry.
